references.text: Contrast between the vegetarian ideal of creation (1:30) and the new permission to eat meat after the flood (9:3).
The creation of green plants (1:11) is the necessary prerequisite for their use as food (1:30).
Theological contrast between the harmony of creation (1:30) and the fear and dominion brought by the flood (9:2).
Leviticus 25:7 is a concrete application of the creation principle in 1:30 within the Sabbath law.
